requirements.quote:
The NewReno congestion controller described in this document has
   three distinct states, as shown in Figure 1.
requirements.condition: When implementing the NewReno congestion controller described in this document
requirements.required_behavior: Represent the controller with three distinct congestion-control states.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Represent the controller with fewer or more than three distinct congestion-control states.
requirements.why_checkable: A test or code inspection can enumerate the controller's distinct states and verify that the count is exactly three.

requirements.quote:
New path or      +------------+
               persistent congestion |   Slow     |
           (O)---------------------->|   Start    |
                                     +------------+
requirements.condition: When a new path is initialized
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Initialize the new path in Recovery Period or Congestion Avoidance.
requirements.why_checkable: A state-machine test can create a new path and assert that its initial congestion-control state is Slow Start.

requirements.quote:
New path or      +------------+
               persistent congestion |   Slow     |
           (O)---------------------->|   Start    |
                                     +------------+
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Remain in or enter Recovery Period or Congestion Avoidance instead of Slow Start.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can establish persistent congestion from a non-Slow-Start state and observe that the controller transitions to Slow Start.

requirements.quote:
+------------+
                                           |
                                   Loss or |
                           ECN-CE increase |
                                           v
    +------------+     Loss or       +------------+
    | Congestion |  ECN-CE increase  |  Recovery  |
    | Avoidance  |------------------>|   Period   |
requirements.condition: When loss is detected while the controller is in Slow Start
requirements.required_behavior: Transition to the Recovery Period state.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Remain in Slow Start or transition directly to Congestion Avoidance.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can inject a loss event in Slow Start and inspect the resulting controller state.

requirements.quote:
+------------+
                                           |
                                   Loss or |
                           ECN-CE increase |
                                           v
    +------------+     Loss or       +------------+
    | Congestion |  ECN-CE increase  |  Recovery  |
    | Avoidance  |------------------>|   Period   |
requirements.condition: When an ECN-CE increase is detected while the controller is in Slow Start
requirements.required_behavior: Transition to the Recovery Period state.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Remain in Slow Start or transition directly to Congestion Avoidance.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can inject an ECN-CE increase in Slow Start and inspect the resulting controller state.

requirements.quote:
+------------+     Loss or       +------------+
    | Congestion |  ECN-CE increase  |  Recovery  |
    | Avoidance  |------------------>|   Period   |
requirements.condition: When loss is detected while the controller is in Congestion Avoidance
requirements.required_behavior: Transition to the Recovery Period state.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Remain in Congestion Avoidance or transition to Slow Start solely because of this loss event.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can inject a loss event in Congestion Avoidance and inspect the resulting controller state.

requirements.quote:
+------------+     Loss or       +------------+
    | Congestion |  ECN-CE increase  |  Recovery  |
    | Avoidance  |------------------>|   Period   |
requirements.condition: When an ECN-CE increase is detected while the controller is in Congestion Avoidance
requirements.required_behavior: Transition to the Recovery Period state.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Remain in Congestion Avoidance or transition to Slow Start solely because of this ECN-CE increase.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can inject an ECN-CE increase in Congestion Avoidance and inspect the resulting controller state.

requirements.condition: When a packet that was sent during the Recovery Period is acknowledged
requirements.required_behavior: Transition from Recovery Period to Congestion Avoidance.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Remain in Recovery Period after that acknowledgment or transition to Slow Start solely because of it.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can enter recovery, acknowledge a packet sent during that period, and assert the resulting state is Congestion Avoidance.
